title: Hardcore Reimaginated
description: With this mod you can transform your normal world into an even more difficult Hardcore world!
body:
# ❤️ Hardcore Reimaginated
By Nicky2023SPX

<hr>

This mod introduces a new way to play Minecraft Hardcore with your friends!

# Features
- When you die you will become a spectator, but you will not drop any loot!
- Chat is now disabled. You can't both send or receive messages!

# Easter Egg
On the home screen there is a 1 in 20 chance that the splash will show "Reimaginated Hardcore". Have you ever found it?
